note: Every line item of the Steam news posts, keyed by date, the post index and a hash of its text (tools/coverage/news.mjs). rows: the FEATURES.md rows that cover what the item describes. na: a reason code from reasons for items that describe no feature of the release.

reasons.greeting: A greeting, thanks, sign-off or request for feedback: it says nothing about how the game behaves.
reasons.heading: A heading or summary line that only names the line items after it; those items are mapped on their own.
reasons.marketing: Announcement or marketing text (trailers, wishlists, community events, launch date, price, sales milestones, Discord): no game feature.
reasons.playtest: Logistics or scope of a playtest or demo build (sign-up, schedule, access keys, feedback forms, test goals, what that build contained): no feature of the release.
reasons.demo: Content or limits of a pre-release demo that the release this recreation follows dropped or replaced (demo-only achievements, the 20-day demo storyline, features the demo still lacked).
reasons.roadmap: A plan or promise about future work that names no feature concretely enough to map; features that shipped are mapped where a post describes them.
reasons.design: Studio background, premise or design intent without a concrete feature; the features it names are mapped where they are described.
reasons.faq: An FAQ answer about the product (price, platforms, multiplayer, Workshop, demo saves, mods, bug reporting) that describes no in-game feature.
reasons.platform: An operating-system, hardware, driver, display, antivirus, Steam-client or install matter of the original Windows client, outside a browser game.
reasons.client-fix: A fix for a crash, freeze, stutter, loading, memory, save-writing or UI-framework failure of the original Unity client; the behaviour it restores is a feature row already, the defect has no counterpart to cover.
reasons.visual-fix: A fix or polish of the original 3D presentation (models, animations, lighting, collision and pathing snags, icons, camera glitches, text layout); presentation belongs to the art and UI lanes and no FEATURES row tracks such glitches.
reasons.ambience: Ambient presentation of the original 3D world (street traffic, wandering extras, shop customers, lighting mood) with no rule behind it: art lane, no FEATURES row.
reasons.text-fix: A wording, typo, translation or description correction of the original text: no behaviour to cover.
reasons.version: A version number or build label.
reasons.tips: Advice to testers on working around a test build's bugs (cancel and click elsewhere when stuck): no feature.
